draft.emotion: a warm and pleasant observation, noticing two people together in public
notes: From English 'couple', but used in Japanese almost exclusively for two people in a romantic relationship (usually unmarried). Married couples are called 夫婦 (ふうふ, fūfu), and a general pair of people is 二人組 (ふたりぐみ, futarigumi).
